data.text: SQUAWK! Manya, you look so EXCITED. That's because the trip is EXCITING! Do you see how those words change?

rules.title: The -ing vs -ed Rule
rules.explainA: Use -ing for the thing that causes the feeling (The Trip).
rules.explainB: Use -ed for the person who has the feeling (Manya).
rules.teacherNote: The movie is INTERESTING, so the student is INTERESTED.

questions.hint: Describe the match, not a person.

data.speaker: manya
data.text: Oh no! I forgot my swimsuit! If I had remembered my swimsuit, I would have gone swimming in the stream.

rules.title: The 'Regret' Formula
rules.formula: If + had + V3 ... would have + V3
rules.teacherNote: This rule is for things that DID NOT happen in the past.

questions.prompt:
Complete the sentence:
If I _______ (see) him, I would have given him a gift.

Complete the result:
If it had rained, the crops _______ (grow) well.
If Manya _______ (prepare) well, he would have enjoyed the trip.

media.content: THE YOUTH CAMP Last December, Kato and Babirye attended a youth camp at Najja Community Hall. They learnt how to appreciate themselves and grow up socially. They also learnt skills like baking, weaving, and tailoring. By the time the camp ended, they had decided to start poultry farming to earn some money.
